Leah (Myra Clinic): Morning team — small pilot tomorrow 09:00 SGT. Need header allowlist on ap-northeast-1 and a cold fallback to sa-east-1. CIDR: 203.0.113.96/27. Request qps=800 for a 7h window with auto-revoke. Please capture token spend; renewal in ~2w so we'll need metrics.
Sam (CS): Got it. What's UTC start and steady vs peak? I'll mark renewal risk if bursts are sustained.
Leah (Myra Clinic): Start = 01:00 UTC. Steady ~320 qps, spikes to 800 for 6-8m every 30m. No mTLS, header auth: `x-myra-key`.
Diego (Network Ops): Need CIDR ownership proof and header name (got it). Proposed auto_revoke timestamp OK? Also what fallback trigger percent?
Asha (Solutions): Draft config — please confirm before prod push:
`{customer: myra-clinic, cidrs: [203.0.113.96/27], regions: [ap-northeast-1, sa-east-1], qps: 800, duration: 7h, auto_revoke: 2024-07-25T08:00:00Z, allow_header: "x-myra-key", fallback_threshold_pct: 85}`
Sam (CS): I'll flag renewal status = "monitoring" and schedule a 30m post-pilot debrief. We'll request perf snapshots at 30m and 2h and a consolidated spend report.
quota-bot: Quota request created: +8k tokens/hr for myra-clinic during window. Approve with `/approve quota 3219876540`
Sam (CS): Approved. :white_check_mark:
Diego (Network Ops): Applying to staging now. Staging smoke: `curl -I https://proxy.tokyo.redwood/health` -> `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`. Prod cutover 15m before start, monitoring p50 and 5xx.
Asha (Solutions): Canary started 14m before start, healthy. Prod push at 00:46 UTC, fallback routing to sa-east-1 set at 85% util.
Diego (Network Ops): Monitoring dashboards live. Alert rules: p50>230ms or 5xx>0.5% -> page. Posting 30m perf snapshot after go-live.
Leah (Myra Clinic): Thanks — please attach spend + perf snapshot to the ticket. We'll review before renewal.
quota-bot: Quota change approved and active.
Diego (Network Ops): Prod live at 00:46 UTC. Good luck with the pilot! :rocket:
